title: Is Organic Food Less Processed?
description: DSC 106 Project 1. A dot plot of 25,849 grocery products comparing organic and regular processing scores aisle by aisle. Overall organic looks far less processed, but within the same aisle the gap mostly disappears.

title: Climate Change Is Real: Persuasive Visualizations
description: DSC 106 Project 2, a group project. A choropleth and year-over-year charts built from the IMF's annual surface temperature data to argue that global temperatures have risen meaningfully since the mid-20th century.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This site. Built across the DSC 106 labs with HTML, CSS and JavaScript: a generated nav bar, a dark mode switch, a contact form, and project cards rendered from a JSON file.

title: MindfulAI, AI Usage Analytics Chrome Extension
description: A Chrome extension that logs AI tool interactions into a structured dataset, plus a Python pipeline that classifies usage by intent (studying, coding, entertainment) and aggregates the raw logs into analysis-ready outputs.

title: Product Review Sentiment Analysis
description: Data analytics externship at Beats by Dre. Cleaned consumer datasets with Pandas and SQL, then ran sentiment analysis on 1,000+ product reviews to surface recurring pain points for the analytics team.

title: Content Performance Analysis Using Statistical Modeling
description: Modeled how content attributes relate to ratings and viewership across 6,000+ records, using bootstrapping, Monte Carlo simulation and hypothesis testing, with a Matplotlib visualization suite for a non-technical audience.

title: Operational Performance Dashboard
description: SQL queries with multi-table joins and window functions feeding interactive Tableau dashboards that track KPIs, distributions and time-series trends.

title: Personal Finance Club Workshops
description: Founded a campus Personal Finance Club and built its workshop curriculum on budgeting and investing, presenting to audiences of 70+ students.
